metric_notes.citation_precision: share of answers whose citations all support their claims (citations_ok; the judge records one verdict per answer)
metric_notes.claim_precision: supported claims / all claims, pooled over passes
metric_notes.fact_recall: gold facts present / gold facts, pooled over passes
metric_notes.abstention_correct: share of answers that abstained exactly when unanswerable
metric_notes.hit_rate: a gold article among the cited sources (answerable questions only)
